title: Stranger in Long John Silver's says read Ezekiel, Daniel, Revelations
place_text: Long John Silver's restaurant, near Fort Knox

tellings.quote: and this guy walks right up to me, who I describe in the book, and says, "Read Ezekiel, Daniel, Revelations." and walked away.

plain: In 1976, in a Long John Silver's fast-food restaurant near Fort Knox, the Army post in Kentucky, a stranger walked straight up to a young Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, told him "Read Ezekiel, Daniel, Revelations," three books of the Bible full of visions and prophecy, and walked away. Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior CIA officer, tells it as his own experience and describes the man in his book A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA. He tells it as an odd, pointed message that seemed meant for him.
